title: Friends Of Appropriate Ages
summary: Given an array of n ages, count the number of friend requests made according to specific age-based conditions.
statement: Given an array of n ages, count the number of friend requests made according to specific age-based conditions. A person x does not send a request to y if y's age is less than or equal to half of x's age plus 7, or if y's age is greater than x's age, or if y's age is greater than 100 and x's age is less than 100. Otherwise, x sends a request to y. Note that a request from x to y does not guarantee a request from y to x, and a person does not send a request to themselves.
constraints: Count directed requests where recipient age b is not <=0.5a+7, not >a, and not >100 when a<100.
hints: Only ages matter, so aggregate people into 120 buckets.
Test each sender-age/receiver-age pair once and multiply their frequencies.
For every legal a,b add count[a]*(count[b]-(a==b)).
Frequency multiplication counts all directed person pairs, and subtracting same-person choices handles equal ages.
editorial: Frequency multiplication counts all directed person pairs, and subtracting same-person choices handles equal ages.

tests.explanation: Each sixteen-year-old may request the other, producing two directed requests.
The valid directed requests total two.
